mcqs.question: Under the Union Budget 2026–27, what was the allocation and objective of the SME Growth Fund?
options: ₹10,000 crore to establish speciality chemical parks
mcqs.explanation: The SME Growth Fund was allocated ₹10,000 crore to create “champion SMEs”. The ₹2,000 crore figure relates to the additional allocation for the Atmanirbhar Bharat Fund, not the SME Growth Fund.

mcqs.question: What additional allocation was announced for the Atmanirbhar Bharat Fund in Union Budget 2026–27?
mcqs.explanation: The Atmanirbhar Bharat Fund received an additional ₹2,000 crore. ₹10,000 crore was associated with the SME Growth Fund, while ₹40,000 crore was the allocation for the electronics components manufacturing scheme.
